lines.text: Azariah, Johanan and the arrogant men call Jeremiah a liar and say Baruch is inciting him against them.
Johanan and the commanders take the whole remnant of Judah, including Jeremiah and Baruch, instead of staying in Judah.
The group enters Egypt and goes as far as Memphis because they did not obey the voice of the LORD.
The LORD tells Jeremiah to bury large stones at Solomon's palace, and says He will set Nebuchadnezzar's throne over them.
Nebuchadnezzar will strike down Egypt, burn the temples of its gods, and take their gods as captives.
